workflows.description: Create a separately accepted product-faithful scene, then use it in a modular product detail-page set.
finalAcceptance: product identity and verified facts are preserved
requested modules and delivery manifest are complete

workflows.description: Produce two or more independently usable campaign formats from one frozen brief.

steps.skillSelector: For each requested format, select the narrowest owner of that independently usable campaign output.

finalAcceptance: all outputs use the same frozen message and visual constraints
each requested format is independently usable

workflows.description: Turn a story into a validated comic manifest, reusable character identities, and rendered pages.

steps.when: comic-manifest identifies a character without an accepted canonical reference
accepted artwork has only a dialogue or speech-bubble defect

finalAcceptance: page order, character identity, style, and dialogue match the manifest
every requested page has one accepted final

workflows.description: Create continuity-linked shots and assemble them when no single finished-outcome Skill owns the requested film.

steps.when: the assembled video has a cross-shot color mismatch

finalAcceptance: all requested shots are present in order
continuity, timing, sound mode, and delivery format match the approved plan

workflows.description: Localize several source and locale pairs under one frozen copy and visual-preservation contract.

steps.skillSelector: Select create-social-carousel or create-image-deck only when the user requested a separately composed series.
steps.when: the requested deliverable includes a composed carousel or deck

finalAcceptance: approved meaning and named terms are preserved in every locale
non-text imagery and layout remain within the preservation contract

workflows.description: Create a reusable transparent cutout, then feed it into a separately owned layout deliverable.

steps.skillSelector: Select the narrowest owner of the requested banner, poster, carousel, deck, thumbnail, or other layout.

finalAcceptance: the transparent master remains separately usable
the requested layout preserves the accepted cutout and content hierarchy

workflows.description: Create a dated evidence artifact whose verified facts materially control a later creative deliverable.

steps.skillSelector: Select the narrowest owner of the requested final visual or media deliverable.

finalAcceptance: unstable claims are traceable to the dated evidence brief
the final deliverable uses only verified claims within the requested scope
